verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform, and such platforms could plausibly offer configurable automations with version history, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only payment APIs, SDKs, subscriptions and payment plans, bulk transfers, and recurring payment links. Nothing shows versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations or configurations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
